limits: Certificate-chain mathematics and limited date/usage/extension checks are not full PKIX/OEM trust validation.
The real catalog lacks its Nokia PK issuer. Independently authenticated OEM anchors, device binding, OEM policies and authenticated revocation evidence remain unavailable.
A matching hardware variant does not establish product-code/region/operator applicability or rollback acceptance.
The image remains numerically older than saved phone firmware, and recovery execution remains blocked.
No proprietary firmware/registry/catalog bytes, root certificates, serials, phone public IDs or personal paths are published. Synthetic fixture certificates are public test data, never trust anchors.
